hero.headline: Home repairs and improvements in Richmond, handled fast and priced fairly.
hero.subhead: Repairs, leak fixes, installs, steps, decks and home improvements across Richmond, Chesterfield and Hopewell. Send the job and get a clear written estimate.

skyeGreeting: Hi, I'm the AJ's Maintenance assistant. Got a repair, an install or a home improvement project? Tell me about it and I'll help you get an estimate or someone out to look.

about.headline: Someone who answers, shows up and fixes it right.
about.body: Whether it's a leak, an install nobody else will take on, or a list of repairs before a sale, most people want the same things: a quick response, an honest price and work done properly. That's how every job is handled.

cards.title: Homes going on the market

cards.title: Family who need a hand
cards.body: Installs and small jobs for elderly relatives, handled with care, often the same day.

about.closing: Not sure if it's worth a call? Send the job and we'll let you know.

realReviews.author: Nikki Lozano
realReviews.text: AJ helped my client not only complete repairs while his home was on the market, but save thousands of dollars that another contractor was quoting.  He found the source of a leak, repaired it in record time and saved my client money.  He is professional, knowledgeable, and responsive.  If you are looking for a contractor in the Richmond/Hopewell area, look no further!  Call AJ!!

realReviews.author: Velvet Cooper
realReviews.text: My sister is elderly and did not have an air conditioner.  We purchased a window unit but had no one to install it. AJ quickly responded and went out the same day we called. Installed at a resonable rate. Thanks to him she was cool last night. Thanks for your kind heart and professionalism. Great job. Looking forward to working with u on additional projects.

finalCta.headline: Got a repair or project that needs doing?
finalCta.body: Send a few details or pick a time that suits you. You'll get a written estimate before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straightforward conversation about the job.

faq.a: Send the job through the form or give us a call. We'll look at it and send a written estimate before any work starts.
Richmond and the surrounding area, including Bon Air, Chesterfield, Chester, Bellwood, Hopewell, Petersburg and Prince George. Close by but not on the list? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Can you handle repairs before a home sale?
faq.a: Yes. Pre-sale repair lists are done quickly and priced fairly, and agents are welcome to send the list on behalf of their clients.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your job.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to set a time.
